text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: spike in external function call failures and tail latency in us-west-2 for hosted API. Error rate 18% over 5m, p95 latency 2.1s. Auto-mitigation suggestions: scoped rate limits, disable structured_output for affected models, text-only fallback. Paging on-call.

maya: acked — I'm on it. grabbing context and running quick checks.

jon: seeing correlated KV cache misses and a backlog on runtime shards 7-9. this matches the fncall queue growth.

sre-oncall: thanks. propose immediate soft-curb: 1) suspend external tool/function invocations for free and trial plans in us-west-2, 2) enable text-only fallback for streaming responses to reduce CPU for parsers, 3) tighten per-tenant fncall QPS to 0.2 for all non-enterprise.

maya: agree. preparing commands. will do a rolling apply to avoid control-plane spike.

ops-bot: Running preflight: `runbook check fncall-mitigation` -> OK.

maya: executing now — will target routing layer and feature flags first.

maya: (exec)

```
# disable structured output for heavy models in us-west-2
featureflag set structured_output:false --scope region:us-west-2 --models gptx-*-large
# throttle fncall by plan for us-west-2
ratelimit update --region us-west-2 --feature fncall --plan free,trial --qps 0.2
# enable text-only fallback route
route add fallback:textonly --region us-west-2 --when fncall_unavailable
```

jon: saw the flag change; runtime acked. telemetry shows fncall attempts dropping ~60% in 30s. p95 latency improving.

sre-oncall: good. next: apply tenant-scoped quota reductions for top 5 noisy tenants while we investigate backlog. notify support for customer comms.

liaison-sd: on it — DMing affected accounts with the pre-approved template. I'll escalate any high-severity customers to account execs.

support: queued message batch for impacted customers. note: possibility of degraded structured responses (missing JSON metadata) while flag is off.

maya: creating incident channel and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-1748123456

ops-bot: mitigation runbook step results: featureflag ok, rate-limit ok, fallback route ok, tenant quotas applied to 5 tenants.

jon: backlog dropping, worker utilization falling back to normal range. still seeing a small error spike on integration proxies; will tail logs.

maya: handing off to SRE for deeper investigation. sre-oncall, you're primary for the next 4h.

sre-oncall: taking handoff. plan: 1) collect full flamegraphs for runtime shards 7-9, 2) inspect third-party agent timeouts, 3) consider temporary routing of high-fanout customers to dedicated pools.

maya: noted. scheduling a quick 10m check-in at +15m.

support: customer comms sent for low/medium impact; waiting on enterprise list for manual pings.

liaison-sd: enterprise pings in progress, three verbal acks so far. no escalations.

jon: adding a defensive quick-fix: reduce parser concurrency for structured-output handler to 2 in us-west-2 to limit memory spikes.

maya: deployed parser concurrency change. monitoring.

sre-oncall: metrics look stable. keeping mitigation in place for at least 1hr while we root cause. recommend keeping structured_output disabled for heavy models in region until next deploy removes the parser hot path.

maya: agreed. I'll keep the incident open and update status in the channel. please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your tasks.

support: :white_check_mark: all customer-notify messages sent.

liaison-sd: :white_check_mark: enterprise contacts notified.

jon: :white_check_mark: logs collected and tailing.

sre-oncall: :white_check_mark: taking action items. will post RCA timeline once we have root cause.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; system p95 latency down to 0.9s, fncall error rate down to 3% over 5m. continued monitoring recommended.

maya: thanks everyone. closing immediate mitigation, keeping follow-ups in INC-1748123456.
